event.title: Supreme Court Allows Trump to Move Forward with Mail Voting Restrictions
event.canonical_title: Supreme Court Allows Trump to Move Forward with Mail Voting Restrictions
event.summary: The Supreme Court has granted a 6-3 decision allowing the Trump administration to proceed with parts of an executive order aimed at restricting mail voting. This order includes the creation of 'state citizenship lists' and gives the Postal Service authority over mail-in ballot distribution. The ruling does not represent a final decision on the legality of the order, as the administration seeks to implement these changes ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.

timeline.title: Supreme Court Decision Allows Trump's Ballroom Project to Move Forward
timeline.summary: The US Supreme Court has ruled in favor of allowing a ballroom project associated with Donald Trump to proceed. The decision was supported by five of the court's six conservative justices. Trump expressed his approval of the ruling on his Truth Social platform.
key_facts: US Supreme Court ruled in favor of Trump's ballroom project
